findings.description: The built-in exact-key build (cachekey = host+target+'\n'+AE, line 88) behaves identically on these depth probes: /api?x, /api/?x and /?x refetch, /?x serves the local static index. Its only cache-key divergence from the other three is the missing wildcard arm on Accept-Encoding, confirmed separately below.
